pr.title: [codex] restore canonical compose
pr.body:
## Summary
- restore compose.yml to the hand-authored canonical root compose format
- preserve the current root build-context semantics for services that need repo-wide build context
- remove stale root docker-compose.unified.yml and harden compose guard against future root-level compose drift

## Root cause
PR #505 normalized compose.yml while changing build contexts, which stripped canonical comments and temporarily produced invalid YAML. Later repair preserved the normalized form. Current compose guard also fails because leantime-bridge references a missing env file.

## Validation
- python scripts/compose_guard.py
- docker compose -f compose.yml config --services
- targeted architecture tests
- git diff --check
- pre-commit run --files <changed files>

@codex @clauee @copilot

Semantic runtime drift is limited to removal of the missing leantime-bridge env_file dependency.

Allow compose/legacy files to remain historical evidence.

validation: No active helper script references docker-compose.unified.yml as a runtime authority.
